findings.summary: Cart remove buttons were named only “Remove,” so assistive technology users could not distinguish the affected product.
findings.fix: Include the product name in each remove button's accessible name.
findings.evidence: Cart rows originally rendered an unlabeled “Remove” button.

findings.summary: Removing a cart row removed the focused button without moving focus to a useful remaining element.
findings.fix: Move focus to the next or previous remove button, or the cart heading when the last item is removed.
findings.evidence: The focused remove button is unmounted after its row is deleted.

passed: Checkout inputs have explicit labels and field errors are associated with aria-describedby.
Route changes move focus to the main content and update the page title.
The remove buttons now include product names, and removal moves focus to a remaining button or the cart heading.
notes: Findings were recorded before their indicated fixes; the final implementation was verified afterward.
